scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.test:py: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.format: npm run format:js && uv run ruff format worker tests lab
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,json}" "worker/**/*.json" "lab/**/*.json" "*.{json,ts,html,md}" && uv run ruff format --check worker tests lab
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check worker tests lab
